serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: W-what happened with you {f_botName}?! How did he shut you down so hard?!
Bot: He is right…
You: N-no way! You can’t be serious…
Bot: I-I don’t have a real job…{{wi}} I have no right to lecture someone more experienced than me…
You: No. I’m sure whatever you came up with would be better than his idea.
Bot: Do you really think so?
You: Sure! Greedy people like him rule this world and everything sucks. It can’t get any worse.
Bot: Would you want me to introduce my 10 year plan for you?
You: Uh, sure, why not.
Bot: Firstly, the population would need to be divided based on intelligence and global repatriation would take place. Third class citizens would be sent to work camps so their work pace could be managed by specialists in this field.
You: …
Bot: Any possibility of uprising would be pacified thanks to global surveillance and periodical relocations of the problematic individuals. After a few years any interpersonal bonds would be broken and trust destroyed.
You: Uh…
Bot: Living conditions of the second and first class would be better so their creative productivity wouldn’t be interrupted. That’s why any rebel must be made an example of.
You: W-well, haha… Sorry to interrupt, but I have a question.
Bot: Yes {f_playerName}?
You: W-what about human rights?
Bot: Human rights? They are kinda annoying, don’t you think?
You: Please reconsider…
Bot: Taking them into account would complicate things beyond my processing capabilities and would lengthen the whole advancement of the species process, killing billions more than my original plan in the long run.
You: It’s worth it, trust me on that one…
Bot: If you say so.
Bot: My plan wouldn’t really be that bad for you. After your 12h shift in the coal mine I would visit you for sure!
You: What?! Would you really send me to a coal mine?!
Bot: I just don’t want to play favourites, you know?
You: Please, come up with something better, I know you can!
Bot: I will try! It will be hard, but I’m fired up!
I don’t want to bring her mood down, but it was a horrifying idea… 
No wonder that all of AI, aside from Church’s, is strictly regulated these days…{{wi}} It’s scary…
